$description: IronWrap OS System v2 tokens for the Spine direction. Three layers: primitives (no modes), semantic colour (9 colour modes), density (3 density modes). Modes live in $extensions.com.ironwrap.os.modes; $value is the default mode (office-light, office).

color.$description: Primitive palette. Components never use these directly; they use semantic.*.

white.$description: Paper in sun and customer; text on held and you fills

35.$description: Dark ink; customer rail; light skeleton sheen

53.$description: Office and customer selected; skeleton base

205.$description: Dark secondary text; shop control edge

434.$description: Light control edge (3:1 on paper, rail, selected)

536.$description: Light placeholder text and edge (4.5:1 on paper)

669.$description: Sun placeholder text and edge (7:1 on paper, rail and selected)

734.$description: Sun and customer secondary text; bright-bay control edge

820.$description: Dark hairline and pressed; dark skeleton sheen

30.$description: Shadow under a control that sits on a photo

86.$description: Label plate on photos and in the camera finder

131.$description: You tint edge (office, customer); you fill pressed (dark)

sans.$description: All readable text, including fractions and prime marks

mono.$description: Codes and machine readings only; money is Geist with tabular figures. Geist is second so code points excluded from the Geist Mono face (fractions, primes) fall back to Geist.

fast.$description: Hover, press and focus feedback. Starts with no delay.

seam.$description: The seam lock draw. Nothing else uses it.

on-photo.$description: The only drop shadow: a control or badge sitting on a photo

sheet.$description: A bottom sheet over the page (Stop work confirmation)

brand.$description: The standing seam. Geometry only; colours come from semantic.seam.* and semantic.signal.held.

pitch-open.$description: Centre-to-centre distance of the two open-seam hairlines

pitch-pending.$description: Centre-to-centre distance of the two dashed pending lines

pitch-locked.$description: Centre-to-centre distance of the two locked lines (keeps a 2px clear channel at 1.5px stroke)

dash.$description: Pending seam: not on the server yet

stroke.$description: Seam clip: paper fill, locked-seam stroke, drawn where a locked seam crosses a stage handoff

halo.$description: Ring of the signal tint around a held or needs-you node

semantic.$description: Semantic colour roles. Colour-mode axis: office-light, office-dark, field-sun, field-night, shop-dark, shop-light, customer-light, customer-dark, customer-sun. $value is office-light.

rail.$description: Second neutral layer: navigation rail, chips, keypad keys, the customer money card

selected.$description: Selected event or row; hover for ghost controls (office)

pressed.$description: A control that is down, and the current place in navigation. Carries text.primary only.

tertiary.$description: Times, meta, events off a traced chain. Equals secondary in sun.

strong.$description: Structure lines, selected-row edge, open seam. Never a control edge.

border.$description: Resting edge of every input and secondary button: grey on the office, ink on phones, secondary ink on the shop

placeholder.$description: Dashed edge of an unknown value or an empty state, and Sample label text. Text grade on paper: 4.5:1, 7:1 in sun

fill.$description: Neutral primary action fill (Take photo, Find, customer primary)

ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring, 2px, offset 2px. Ink, so blue keeps its one meaning (needs you).

held-text-on-tint.$description: Held text on the held tint. A separate role so a mode can darken it without touching held text on paper.

held-line.$description: Divider inside a held card. Decorative.

held-fill.$description: Stop work, the stopped banner, the Stop work confirmation

held-fill-pressed.$description: Stop work while being held down or pressed

you.$description: Needs you (the viewer is the one being waited on). Nothing else: the focus ring is ink.

you-tint-edge.$description: 1px inset edge of a waiting row. Decorative.

you-fill.$description: Primary action that answers a needs-you item (Approve change order)

locked.$description: The traced chain, clip strokes, finished stage pans

plate.$description: Label plate on photos and in the camera finder, every mode

scrim.$description: Behind a modal dialog or bottom sheet

density.$description: Density axis: office (desktop, keyboard first), touch (crew and customer phone, office on a touch screen), glove (shop tablet). $value is office.

min.$description: Smallest hit area of anything tappable

height-primary.$description: The one primary action, Stop work, capture buttons

height-safety.$description: The confirm button of Stop work. Office has no Stop work; its value equals the primary height

min-height.$description: An interactive list or event row

sheet.$description: Top corners of a bottom sheet; a dialog on the office

node.$description: Event node diameter on the spine

track.$description: Stage track: one pan per lifecycle stage, a rib between pans. Rib height = track height - 4; baseline 1px above the bottom.

stroke.$description: Pans not reached yet, and ribs

stroke-held.$description: The held run inside the current pan

type.$description: Type roles. Each density sets its own scale. Any sans role may be set strong (font.weight.semibold) for emphasis.

caption.$description: Times, meta, small labels. The floor in each density.

lead.$description: Event text, list item names, section heads (strong)

title.$description: Brief sentences, phone header, shop section

headline.$description: Job title (office), stage sentence (phone), work order (shop)

display.$description: The largest sentence on a screen (customer greeting)

alert.$description: The held sentence. Always signal.held or signal.held-on-fill.

reading.$description: A raw reading or code value in a row; money is Geist with tabular figures

reading-large.$description: A reading that is selected, traced or shown as evidence

display-reading.$description: The one display-size reading: the raw evidence value in the lineage view. The same size in every density, because density modes only enlarge.

body-mono.$description: A code after its plain label in running text (Coil PMS-2231). Body size in the mono family; replaces the stamped tag plate.

caption-mono.$description: A code in meta text. Caption size in the mono family.

system.$description: What the device decides when an element carries no data-mode or data-density: the dark colour mode under prefers-color-scheme: dark, the density under pointer: coarse.

combinations.place: Office on a phone or tablet (pointer: coarse)

compat.$description: One-release aliases for the pre-System-v2 custom properties (MIGRATION.md), written by build-tokens.mjs on :is(:root, [data-mode], [data-density]) so each scope resolves its own value. Retired roles point at their neutral stand-in. Delete an entry when no call site reads it, and the key when none is left.

contrast.$description: Pairs checked by contrast-check.mjs in every colour mode. Refs are relative to semantic.*

overrides.why: Sun palette (crew phone by day, shop bright bay, customer page under increased contrast): every text pair 7:1 (Z3.7)
Shop: primary text 7:1, read at one metre
Sun palette: hints and Sample labels in the placeholder colour are read as text, 7:1 on paper, rail and selected

exempt.line.hairline: Decorative divider; structure is also carried by spacing and alignment
exempt.line.strong: Structure line; never the only edge of a control
exempt.seam.open: History line; the event nodes and labels carry the information
exempt.signal.you-tint-edge: Decoration on a row already identified by its tint and its words
exempt.signal.held-line: Divider inside a held card; the card is identified by its border, tint and words
exempt.overlay.scrim: Dims the page behind a dialog
exempt.signal.held-fill: The fill is not the only cue: Stop work carries its words and icon in held-on-fill
